subject: ENGLISH
title: Sight-Word Path · M01 D15
objective: Read and use selected high-frequency words in meaningful sentences.
introduction: Learn the pronunciation, meaning, and spelling pattern of have, said, please, because, there, and where. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.
